comment: risky_globs must never be removed without Tester+Reviewer. They force mode full for trading, live-money, release, deploy, publish, and secret paths (matched case-insensitively). core_globs force mode full because those files change how tests are chosen or run, or they are shared test helpers. structural_globs are docs and catalog intake data. A data file under sources/ or data/ that tests reference by string is mode affected, not structural. A file under data/stages/ also selects tests/test_stage_registry.py, because that module checks every card and does not name each filename. That selection stays affected, not full. A module imported by more than fan_in_core_ratio of test modules is core even when its path is not listed. Unknown or unparseable files are mode full.
